basis: CBF-6/7 and corrected ECA-2/adaptation failed their authored criterion/evidence assays. Direct native NLI heads were already tested in CBF-7. The guarded human-annotated native train/dev exports are complete, but no fit on that projection was found. This study tests state perception under real intent and retained-rater supervision, not another literal-registry or authored-alias rerun.
hypothesis: A shared pretrained state encoder, supervised on lawful native intent and retained-rater targets, yields useful cached categorical/ordinal fields beyond state-blind priors. Compare a frozen encoder readout with full encoder fine-tuning before selecting a more elaborate architecture.

data.reader: neutral_native_compile.open_phase only; phases train and dev, never calibration/confirmation/final/unused
data.selection: Every Banking77 row and exactly MASSIVE en-US, determined from provenance before target values. Preserve source-native targets, candidate catalogues and natural prevalence. No class rebalance, synthetic labels, rationale inputs or new source allocation.
data.train_permission: This separate protocol explicitly authorizes native train payloads/targets for fitting; the earlier DEV-only competitor comparison did not authorize training.
data.inner_split: Whole original train components: int(SHA256('native-field-v1|7|'+component_id),16) mod100; 0..69 fit,70..84 checkpoint-selection,85..99 temperature-calibration. Components never split across tasks or duplicate lineages. Original dev remains development assessment, not a sealed final.
data.ordinal_eligibility: All source-retained distributions with >=1 observed rater. RPS screens and NLL/Brier use >=3; all>=1 RPS is separately descriptive and nMAE uses all>=1. Census first. A rubric needs >=250 fit and >=100 dev records to earn this English assessment; otherwise retain counts and mark it data-insufficient, never fabricate a trained head or grade gate. An eligible rubric with zero >=3-rater dev rows has an insufficient distributional screen.
data.memory: Stream all four guarded native files once per phase. Filter provenance to selected English IDs before retaining serving/target/decision objects. Do not use the all-record in-memory comparison join for train. Persist selected DecisionIR IDs, component IDs, inputs, targets and original export hashes outside Git.

model.source: Existing pinned stock checkpoint; no NLI-derived conditional/review checkpoint substitution or competitor weights.
model.inputs: Canonical serving state text only. Endpoint/candidate catalogue chooses the declared native field in code. Questions/candidate descriptions are persisted but not encoded by this pooled field model. This is typed native state perception, not free-form question or alias interpretation.
model.pooling: Existing EncoderPool/masked_mean behavior, then one Linear384->256/GELU/Linear256->C head per eligible endpoint, matching train/vey_u_school.py PooledClassifier pattern. One state encoder call yields all endpoint logits.
model.cache: Eval-mode encoded state and full endpoint logits/probabilities cached by exact serving state bytes and model identity. Choice gathers native catalogue coordinates; ordinal expectation/CDF and canonical intent membership Boolean are exact code over learned masses. No numeric-fact arithmetic in the network.
model.semantic_scope: Canonical endpoint/catalogue IDs only; no candidate alias recognition, free-form criteria, many-axis promotion, generic Boolean truth, OOD detector or SSC claim. Unsupported/untrained endpoints fail explicitly.

training.optimizer: AdamW; head lr0.001, full encoder lr0.00002, weight_decay0.01; no schedule or hyperparameter sweep
training.loss: Categorical CE and soft-target ordinal CE. Sum valid per-decision losses and divide by valid decisions in each effective batch; each eligible source decision has weight1, no class weights. Group co-occurring endpoints by source row_key, encode the shared state once. Missing ratings contribute no ordinal loss.
training.frozen_features: Frozen arm caches detached eval-mode pooled state embeddings and fits heads only. Full arm encodes with gradients; never cache/detach trainable activations.
training.checkpoint: Highest macro source intent accuracy on inner selection components; tie lower mean per-endpoint unweighted NLL then earlier epoch. Restore selected state_dict strictly and verify its fingerprint before calibration/dev. Include epoch0 in selection.
training.calibration: Fit one temperature per eligible endpoint on disjoint inner calibration components only, bounded0.5..10, deterministic101-point log grid, lower NLL then temperature closest1. Raw and calibrated predictions retained. No dev temperature fit.
training.smoke: Before full training, actual tiny forward/backward/optimizer step: finite loss; nonzero named active encoder gradient and parameter delta for full arm; unchanged encoder hash for frozen arm; active head gradients; strict save/restore fingerprint; cached and uncached eval agreement. Smoke state discarded and fresh seeded arms instantiated.

controls.state_blind: Fit-only empirical target mass per endpoint, with zero probabilities scored at1e-12; no dev label prior.
controls.state_mask: On dev replace every state with the same public empty-evidence string; preserve heads/catalogues. Compare actual target performance to real-state performance.
controls.state_swap: Within each endpoint, cyclically map lexicographically sorted dev decision IDs to the next different component with a different native intent label or ordinal mean; persist donor IDs. Predict donor state against original targets; also assess correct-new on donor targets. Report teacher-changing denominators. No invented counterfactual gold. If no valid donor exists, persist donor-unavailable IDs/counts, supply no swapped semantic credit, and report insufficient intervention data.
controls.candidate_order: Reverse candidate IDs and map masses by ID; winner/ties must remain semantic-ID consistent. This is exact coordinate-order invariance, not candidate alias semantics.
controls.repeated_state: Actual cached path returns Choice, expected ordinal level/CDF and canonical intent-membership Boolean without another state-encoder call. Counter and numeric equality measured, no latency inference.

statistics.unit: Input-only connected component, preserving all selected descendants/tasks
statistics.estimand: Row-weighted paired endpoint metric difference using ratio bootstrap over component sums/counts
statistics.intervals: Nominal descriptive95%; not the endgame simultaneous non-inferiority gate
statistics.choice: Accuracy, per-class counts, NLL,Brier,ECE15, raw/calibrated; no gold-probability ECE
statistics.ordinal: MAE/nMAE,bias,slope,Spearman on all observed>=1; normalized RPS screens and retained-rater NLL/Brier on>=3, all>=1 RPS separately descriptive; finite retained-rater agreement, never population calibration

screen_gates.scope: Development mechanism screens only. Rubrics earn credit independently; passing intent does not rescue failing/missing ordinal fields. No competitor victory or many-axis promotion.

selection: All three controls completed; choose smallest declared learned arm passing each field's screens, otherwise no earned field. Do not read or manufacture a final. No failed rubric/arm is hidden.
next_branch: Passing native perception proceeds to separately preregistered pooled/cross/dual/Evidence Pages and variable-query/many-axis transfer comparisons; these remain required, not waived. If full native fit fails, audit representation/task/loss/optimization and strongest source-native cross teacher before larger capacity. Do not return to retired authored registry/NLI-head sweeps.

resources.user_workloads: Never kill user processes. No throughput/latency claim from shared-host quality execution.

custody: Commit protocol and implementation before materialization/model work. Record source/export/model/tokenizer/config hashes, eligibility/inner membership, histories, gradients, encoder hashes, selected restore, temperatures, every prediction/control, independent reconstruction and failure branch. Raw data/checkpoints stay outside Git.
prohibited: claim universal fields from native fixed ontologies
